mentions.name: Leggen
mentions.description: A self-hosted personal banking account management system that syncs bank account transactions and balances into a SQLite database, exposes a PWA interface, and sends Telegram or Discord alerts when transactions match filters. It connects to bank accounts via Enable Banking.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on the last months on Leggen (https://github.com/elisiariocouto/leggen), a self hosted personal banking account management system. It started out as a CLI that syncs your bank account transactions and balances, saves them in a sqlite database and can alert you via Telegram or Discord if a transaction matches a filter. It is now a PWA and uses Enable Banking to connect to the bank accounts
